title: Normalized transitions for localized actual comparisons
statement: For the data and descent equations of lem-weil-pbc-lisse-tower-localized-actual, supply a functor comparison system [lem-weil-pbc-lisse-tower-localization-comparisons]. Define actual_j as its level comparison at D_j, followed by T_j(e_j) and its base comparison at M_j. This constructed family satisfies the displayed normalized transition equation with lisseTowerPulledScalarIso and constantAdicRestrictedStep [lem-weil-pbc-lisse-tower-pulled-scalar, lem-weil-pbc-constant-adic-restricted-tower-maps, def-weil-pbc-constant-adic-finite-diagram-data]. Arbitrary unrelated level isomorphisms are not asserted to satisfy it.

proof.text: Expand each constructed actual comparison into its level, inverse-image-of-e, and base factors. Apply the source coefficient square at delta_n.

Naturality of the scalar comparison at e_n moves e_n to the source side. Functoriality combines the two maps, and hdelta_n replaces their composite by e_(n+1) followed by the actual restricted transition on U.

Apply the target coefficient square to the actual semilinear transition of M. By the definitions lisseTowerInverseImageArrow and lisseTowerProjectedArrow, its conclusion identifies the result with constantAdicRestrictedStep on W. Recombine the constructed actual_(n+1).

Any family of localized level isomorphisms actual_n satisfies the normalized transition equation: after applying the next-level normalization, the pulled scalar comparison, and actual_n, the result equals actual_(n+1) followed by constantAdicRestrictedStep [lem-weil-pbc-lisse-tower-pulled-scalar, lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction, lem-weil-pbc-constant-adic-restricted-tower-maps, def-weil-pbc-constant-adic-finite-diagram-data].
statement_change.what: STATEMENT-DISPUTED: the original conclusion quantified over every family actual without relating it to the supplied descent comparisons e. Changing actual at a single level by a nontrivial automorphism preserves every hypothesis and generally breaks the equation. For constant rank-one F3 coefficients on a geometric point with identity transitions, taking opposite signs in two consecutive levels forces -1=1. The corrected theorem uses the explicit three-factor comparisons of one functor comparison system. The sole parent retains its original existential conclusion and constructs precisely this family.

old_proof.text: Before localization, compare the two composites after forgetting to abelian sheaves; section normalization of the scalar square makes the coefficient-interchange cube commute.
Localize the cube with the canonical inverse-image and restriction compositors, apply the supplied descent equation, and use naturality of the actual comparisons.
Identify the resulting restricted transition with constantAdicRestrictedStep using the all-pairs restricted-tower map theorem and cancel the common invertible comparison factors.
